milestones.label: Application deadline depends on the university
milestones.time_text: set by each of the Shanghai institutions
milestones.source_text: The Study in Shanghai platform of the Shanghai government says each participating university sets its own application window for 2027 and refers applicants to the university admissions pages; the windows differ from institution to institution.

milestones.label: Application window at Shanghai Maritime University (2027 intake)
milestones.source_text: Shanghai Maritime University's own page gives this period for applications for its 2027 intake.

milestones.label: Application deadline for the Shanghai Government Scholarship at Shanghai Jiao Tong University (graduate, 2027)
milestones.source_text: SJTU's official 2027 international graduate guide gives 31 March 2027 for the Shanghai Government Scholarship and SJTU Scholarships.
